# SudheeAI

> AI-powered recruitment platform that replaces resume screening with evidence-based hiring using verified signals from GitHub, LeetCode, and LinkedIn.

SudheeAI helps recruiters rank candidates by real, verified technical ability and helps students understand their job readiness. The platform aggregates multi-platform signals, runs explainable AI ranking, and offers tools for bias detection, interview scheduling, and talent discovery.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of SudheeAI's evidence-based hiring approach.
- [Recruiter Login](/recruiter/login): Sign in portal for recruiters.
- [Recruiter Register](/recruiter/register): Create a recruiter account.
- [Student Login](/student/login): Sign in portal for students.
- [Student Register](/student/register): Create a student account.
